items: The consultant ____ client list includes several major retailers will lead the market study.
The client list belongs to the consultant, so 'whose' is required.
The factory ____ loading dock is under repair has arranged an alternate delivery entrance.
The loading dock belongs to the factory, so 'whose' correctly expresses possession.
Employees ____ travel expenses exceed the allowance must obtain additional approval.
The travel expenses belong to the employees, so 'whose' is required.
The agency ____ contract expires in December has requested a renewal meeting.
The contract is the agency's, so the possessive relative pronoun 'whose' is required.
The researcher ____ findings were cited in the report will speak at the conference.
The findings belong to the researcher, so 'whose' is correct.
The logistics company ____ drivers completed the safety course received a compliance award.
The drivers are those of the logistics company, so 'whose' is required.
Customers ____ orders were delayed by the storm will receive updated delivery estimates.
The orders belong to the customers, so 'whose' is required.
The building ____ elevators are being inspected will close its west entrance temporarily.
The elevators belong to the building, so 'whose' correctly marks possession.
The designer ____ portfolio impressed the selection committee has been offered the position.
The portfolio belongs to the designer, so 'whose' is required.
The supplier ____ prices remained stable was awarded a two-year purchasing agreement.
The prices are those of the supplier, so 'whose' is required.
Managers ____ teams complete the audit early may submit their reports ahead of schedule.
The teams belong to the managers, so 'whose' is the correct possessive relative pronoun.
The museum ____ entrance hall is being renovated will remain open through the side doors.
The entrance hall belongs to the museum, so 'whose' is required.
The attorney ____ advice helped resolve the dispute will review the final agreement.
The advice belongs to the attorney, so 'whose' correctly expresses possession.
The hotel chain ____ occupancy rate rose last quarter plans to renovate three properties.
The occupancy rate is that of the hotel chain, so 'whose' is required.
Applicants ____ résumés meet the minimum requirements will be contacted for interviews.
The résumés belong to the applicants, so 'whose' is required.
The warehouse ____ fire alarm was replaced passed the follow-up safety inspection.
The fire alarm belongs to the warehouse, so 'whose' is correct.
The broker ____ recommendation saved the client money will handle the next transaction.
The recommendation belongs to the broker, so 'whose' is required.
The airline ____ baggage policy was recently revised has posted the new rules online.
The baggage policy belongs to the airline, so 'whose' is required.
Vendors ____ products fail the inspection must replace the affected units at no charge.
The products belong to the vendors, so 'whose' is the correct possessive form.
The theater ____ seating plan was redesigned can now accommodate larger groups.
The seating plan belongs to the theater, so 'whose' is required.
The technician ____ inspection uncovered the wiring problem will prepare the repair estimate.
The inspection was performed by the technician, so 'whose' correctly links the technician to the inspection.
The publisher ____ annual catalog features the new series will distribute copies next month.
The annual catalog belongs to the publisher, so 'whose' is required.
Clients ____ accounts require additional verification will receive instructions by email.
The accounts belong to the clients, so 'whose' is required.
The office ____ lease ends this year is considering two nearby locations.
The lease is for the office, so 'whose' correctly expresses the possessive relationship.
The consultant ____ presentation received the highest evaluation will return for an advanced workshop.
The presentation belongs to the consultant, so 'whose' is required.
